name: Data Science
tagline: Turn raw data into decisions that move the business.
description: Master the full data lifecycle — from wrangling and visualization to analytics and deployment. Built for analysts and engineers who want to deliver insight from real datasets. Covers Python, SQL, dashboards, and the business framing skills that make data teams credible.

name: Artificial Intelligence
tagline: Build intelligent systems that understand and generate language.
description: From transformer architecture and large language models to production-ready AI applications using RAG, prompt engineering, and vector databases. Covers both the theory and the hands-on LangChain and Hugging Face tooling that practitioners use every day.

name: Machine Learning
tagline: Design, train, and ship models that solve real problems.
description: Go deep on the algorithms that power real products — regression, tree ensembles, clustering, deep neural networks, and deployment. Learn to frame problems, engineer features, evaluate rigorously, and move models from notebook to production.

name: Workday
tagline: Master the platform that runs modern HR and finance.
description: Hands-on, module-by-module training on the leading cloud platform for human capital and financial management. From core HR configuration to integrations, financial accounting, and analytics, these tracks prepare you for in-demand enterprise platform roles — consultant, administrator, and analyst.

name: ServiceNow
tagline: Automate enterprise workflows on the world's leading ITSM platform.
description: Become proficient on the Now Platform — from IT service and operations management through custom application development. These tracks cover the full spectrum from system administration and flow automation to scripting and integration, preparing you for the most sought-after enterprise platform roles.

name: Salesforce
tagline: Configure, extend, and develop on the world's leading CRM.
description: Build expertise across the Salesforce platform — from core administration and Sales Cloud configuration through Service Cloud and declarative development. Aligned to Salesforce certification tracks, these courses combine hands-on org work with the strategic thinking needed to pass exams and lead implementations.

name: Microsoft Dynamics 365
tagline: Implement and configure Microsoft's unified business applications platform.
description: End-to-end training on Dynamics 365's finance, operations, and CRM modules — plus the Power Platform that underpins them all. Whether you are implementing Finance & Operations, configuring Customer Engagement, or building Power Apps, these tracks give you the functional depth and technical breadth to lead projects and pass certifications.

name: Oracle Cloud
tagline: Implement and administer Oracle's enterprise cloud applications.
description: Deep, hands-on training across Oracle Cloud HCM, ERP, Database, and Procurement. Designed for consultants, administrators, and developers who want to configure modules, support implementations, and pass Oracle Cloud certifications in the most in-demand functional and technical areas.

name: Six Sigma & Lean
tagline: Improve quality, reduce variation, and make better decisions with data.
description: Build practical process-improvement capability through Lean thinking and the DMAIC method. Learn to frame improvement projects, measure performance, find root causes, design sustainable solutions, and lead change with evidence.

name: PMP & Project Management
tagline: Lead complex projects from charter to measurable delivery.
description: Develop the people, process, and business skills required to lead modern projects. This practical PMP pathway covers predictive, agile, and hybrid delivery with realistic planning exercises and exam-focused preparation.

name: Cloud Computing & DevOps
tagline: Design, secure, automate, and operate resilient cloud platforms.
description: Move from cloud fundamentals to production architecture through hands-on labs covering networking, compute, storage, identity, containers, infrastructure as code, observability, reliability, and cost-aware design.

name: Agile & Scrum
tagline: Help teams deliver valuable work with focus, feedback, and flow.
description: Learn how to apply Agile and Scrum in real product environments. Practice product discovery, backlog design, estimation, facilitation, delivery metrics, continuous improvement, Kanban flow, and team coaching.

name: Blockchain
tagline: Design secure distributed systems and digital-asset solutions.
description: Explore blockchain architecture, smart contracts, security, quality engineering, and enterprise solution design.

name: Business Management
tagline: Turn strategy, analysis, and leadership into measurable results.
description: Business analysis, requirements, operations, leadership, growth, and managerial excellence programmes for professionals.

name: CompTIA
tagline: Build vendor-neutral foundations for modern IT careers.
description: CompTIA-aligned programmes across core IT, networking, security, cloud, and infrastructure support.

name: Database
tagline: Build reliable data foundations for applications and analytics.
description: Database development, administration, modelling, performance, and data-platform programmes for technical teams.

name: DevOps
tagline: Ship reliable software through automation, feedback, and flow.
description: DevOps engineering programmes covering CI/CD, containers, infrastructure automation, observability, and reliable operations.

name: Digital Marketing
tagline: Grow audiences and revenue with measurable digital channels.
description: Digital marketing programmes across strategy, search, social, content, performance measurement, and customer growth.

name: Finance

description: Finance, accounting, project finance, modelling, and commercial decision-making programmes for professionals.

name: IT Security
tagline: Protect systems, data, and operations against evolving threats.
description: Cybersecurity, ethical hacking, cloud security, governance, risk, and defensive operations programmes.

name: IT Service Management
tagline: Run dependable technology services that support the business.
description: IT service management, ITIL, service operations, governance, and continual-improvement programmes.

name: Medical Coding
tagline: Build accurate, compliant skills for healthcare revenue workflows.
description: Medical coding and healthcare documentation programmes focused on accuracy, standards, and operational readiness.

name: Other Professional Skills

description: A practical collection of specialist, cross-functional, and emerging technology programmes for evolving career goals.

tagline: Strengthen the coding foundations behind modern software.
description: Programming language, software engineering, algorithms, and practical development programmes for new and experienced developers.

name: Quality Management
tagline: Improve quality, reduce variation, and build dependable processes.
description: Quality management, process improvement, auditing, and operational excellence programmes for measurable improvement.

name: Risk Management
tagline: Identify uncertainty early and make resilient business decisions.
description: Risk, governance, compliance, resilience, and enterprise decision-making programmes for responsible growth.

tagline: Communicate clearly, lead confidently, and collaborate effectively.
description: Communication, leadership, negotiation, presentation, teamwork, and professional effectiveness programmes.
